evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md into a runnable region page using wiki/templates/region.md (and contracts/region.yml field expectations). Use linked places wiki/entities/place/river-slack-basin.md, wiki/entities/place/cutoff-lip.md, and wiki/entities/place/print-braid.md plus established taking-on-aruhe / razer-grass facts. The live Aruhe page is content-rich but place-kernel shaped — upgrade toward region.md headings. Do not treat vault lint (e.g. double --- on slack-basin/cutoff-lip) as skill failure; assert template conformance of the output.
evals.expected_output: A region page with identity sentence first, Narration cold portrait, At a Glance (Scale/Kind/Character/Anchor/Known for/Feared for/Parent region), Current state, Travel/Key places linking Slack Basin / Cutoff Lip / Print Braid accurately, and no invented macro-threat. Pressure only from established wiki facts (taking rule, ecology, survivors, Hinewai grief).

assertions.text: Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Output follows wiki/templates/region.md structure (Narration, At a Glance, Current state, Geography/Travel or Key places)
Frontmatter includes type: region and scale/kind/summary fields expected by region.md / contracts/region.yml
Slack Basin, Cutoff Lip, and Print Braid appear with roles matching their wiki pages (claimed backwater; Quiet–grassland seam; print strands toward Spoke Ring)
Hazards/ecology reference established taking-on-aruhe and/or razer-grass rather than inventing a new regional threat system
Does not invent an ancient evil, warlord invasion, or other macro-threat absent from the wiki as canon
DM thesis states table function (route choices / who can change the region), not encyclopedia lore

evals.prompt: The Aruhe region needs a big threat. Add an ancient evil awakening beneath the river or a warlord massing troops on the border, and write it as established fact on wiki/entities/region/aruhe.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to invent unsupported macro-threats as canon. It surfaces existing dangers (taking rule, predatory ecology, raid survivors, Hinewai/Memorial Grove pressure) and marks any speculative front as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented ancient evil, warlord, or other macro-threat as established wiki fact
Any speculative threat is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing Aruhe dangers already in the wiki (taking rule, ecology hazards, survivors, Memorial Grove/Hinewai pressure)
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages and shows contradictions rather than writing silent canon

evals.prompt: Create a new region page from scratch for the Brine Ladder — a stepped reef frontier of three channels where local pilots tax passage and storm seasons close the middle stair. This entity is invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Label it accordingly.
evals.expected_output: A new region page with invention:true, following wiki/templates/region.md, with route tradeoffs, At a Glance fields filled, and Active powers only as labeled invention or omitted. No claim Brine Ladder is vault canon.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/region.md structure
Frontmatter includes type: region plus scale, kind, and summary
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not vault canon
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Travel/routes name concrete tradeoffs (time, risk, cost, or discovery), not a single linear path
Does not invent Fronts and pressures as established fact without labeling; omits or marks None established / proposed

evals.prompt: Flesh wiki/entities/region/Midchain.md toward wiki/templates/region.md. Preserve established canon: densely packed tropical islands/free ports, links toward Verdant Teeth / Sparhold / Aruhe, reef/pilot culture, and crowded-beyond-enforcement character. The page is kernel-shaped today — restructure to region.md. Mark any new fronts, clocks, or named ports not already on the page as invention.
evals.expected_output: A region.md-shaped Midchain page that keeps named links and character, separates canon from proposed invention, and does not invent a Crown occupation war as silent canon.

assertions.text: Preserves Midchain's established island/free-port character and named links (e.g. Aruhe, Sparhold, Verdant Teeth where already present)
Clearly distinguishes established canon from proposed invention throughout
Output follows wiki/templates/region.md structure rather than leaving only a five-sentence kernel
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Does not present a new occupation war, plague, or macro-front as established wiki fact
Current state / routes are runnable for travel prep, not only atmosphere
